rationale: Explicit user request to try published top-conference modules. Stage35 showed that recovering more foreground did not establish better segmentation. Test conditional skip filtering and multi-frequency/multi-scale local refinement separately with matched surrounding convolutions; mechanism remains a hypothesis, not a diagnosed cause.

changes.swin_control: Exact previous MambaVision-S + Swin add-skip architecture, newly trained on same4090 physical batch64.
changes.uct_concat: At three skip levels use original UCTransNet UpBlock_attention(128,64,2), replacing only CCA with ReLU(skip); same native nearest upsampling, concatenation and two Conv-BN-ReLU layers; then original shared Swin level.
changes.uct_cca: Same three UpBlocks with unmodified author CCA. Paired surrounding weights identical; no CCT/ChannelTransformer integration. No additional root initialization exists on this UCTransNet runtime path.
changes.madg_concat: Replace only finest64x64 skip fusion with original MADGNet UpsampleBlock(64,64,64), bypass MFMSAttentionBlock with Identity; native bilinear upsampling, concat, conv1/conv2 retained, followed by existing shared Swin.
changes.madg_mfms: Same finest UpsampleBlock with unmodified MFMS attention (two scales,16 top frequencies,groups32,minchannel64,minresolution8). Native C64 DCT56x56 remains;64x64 pooled to56, lower32x32 branch internally uses author adaptive pooling. Do not broadcast block to lower decoder resolutions.
